text: The stale sweep must run once per `check` invocation, at the end of the commit range, rather than per commit.
quote: runs once per `check` invocation, at the end of the range

text: The stale sweep must iterate over every accepted ADR, not only ADRs touched by the diff.
An obligation whose named anchors are all missing from the code at the ref must be reported as stale.
quote: an obligation whose named anchors are all missing from the code at that ref is reported as stale

text: The stale sweep must not make any model call.
Anchor presence must be tested against code only, with comments and docstrings blanked by `strip_python_prose()` before searching.
quote: `strip_python_prose()` blanks comments and docstrings before the search

text: Files whose extensions are in `_PROSE` must be skipped by the sweep's anchor search.
quote: files with extensions in `_PROSE` are skipped

text: A mention of an anchor in a docstring, comment, or markdown file must not count as the code still existing.
quote: so a mention in a docstring or a markdown file never counts as the code still existing

text: An ADR that names no anchors must be reported as unsweepable rather than silently passing or being reported stale.
quote: An ADR that names no anchors cannot be swept and is reported as such.

text: The sweep must read the whole tree at a single ref.
quote: The sweep reads the whole tree at one ref
